pet_notes: Four-legged deer-like weather beast; exact proportions: body length 1.6x shoulder height, head length 1/3 body length, horizontal back when standing, belly above elbow. Off-white nearly achromatic fur with no rainbow on the body. Two separate translucent spectrum antler arcs, one from each side of the head; free open tips never connect, tip gap equals head width; no ring, circle, halo, closed loop. Short tail. Amber/honey irises, round dark pupils, drawn upper lash line, exactly two catchlights per eye, small dark nose, visible paw pads. Shared sibling identity: painterly cel-shaded game-creature art with clean readable outline, soft warm rendering, flat lit palette matching the attached reference.
style_notes: The attached reference is the canonical visual style and character reference. Preserve its painterly cel-shaded rendering, warm off-white fur, clean outline, and facial read. At final 192x208 cell size, keep the two antler arcs separated with a head-width gap and each arc visibly open-ended; rainbow color only in the antlers. No text, logos, scenery, ground shadow, halo, ring, circle, or closed loop.
